title: Blue Owl Loan Sale Raises $1.4 Billion to Fund Investor Payouts
content: Three months after Blue Owl Capital Inc. shelved a merger between two private credit funds, it has found a different way to provide investors with promised liquidity - selling loans.

title: Where to Expect Software Consolidation: Investment Committee
content: Barclays estimates software now makes up about 20% of all loans held by BDCs, making it their largest sector exposure. This week's investment committee on "Bloomberg Deals" discusses the possible pain points in software. Guests include: Nenad Milicevic-Helac, Americas co-leader of TMT Alixpartners, Songyee Yoon, founder and managing partner of Principal Venture Partners, and Anura Rana, Bloomberg Intelligence.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Crypto Firm Ledn Sells Bitcoin-Backed Bonds In ABS Market First
content: Crypto lending firm Ledn Inc. has sold $188 million of securitized bonds backed by Bitcoin, making it the first ever deal of its kind in the market for asset-backed debt.

title: HPS, Sixth Street Provide $700 Million Private Credit Deal for Elara Caring
content: HPS Investment Partners led a roughly $700 million private-credit deal for Elara Caring, a home health-care provider, according to a person familiar with the matter.

title: Fintech Funding Jumped 27% In 2025 With Fewer Deals But Bigger Checks
content: Global venture funding to fintech startups climbed in 2025 to its highest level in several quarters, boosted by later-stage deals, Crunchbase data shows.

title: Seed Funding In 2025 Broke Records Around Big Rounds And AI, With US Far In The Lead
content: The seed investment environment exhibited its typical quirkiness in 2025. In particular, it was a huge year for huge rounds. Predictably, it was also a banner period for AI dealmaking with the U.S. pulling in a bigger-than-usual share of total investment.

title: Credit card debt tops $1.28 trillion — consistent with ‘K-shaped’ economic divide, New York Fed research shows
content: Collectively, Americans owe $1.28 trillion on their credit cards, according to a new report by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.

title: Housing affordability isn't just hurting buyers: More homeowners are falling behind on their mortgages
content: While the overall share of delinquencies among all mortgages remains small, the growth is occurring faster than late payments for other types of consumer loans.

title: Fed holds interest rates steady: What that means for mortgages, credit cards and loans
content: From mortgage rates and auto loans to credit cards and savings accounts, here's a look at how the January Fed decision could affect your finances.

title: Fed is likely to hold interest rates steady, resisting Trump pressure. Here’s what that means for borrowers
content: From mortgage rates to auto loans and credit cards, here’s a look at how the upcoming January Fed decision may affect your finances.

title: Why a niche category of CRE lending is suddenly seeing record deals
content: C-PACE stands for commercial property assessed clean energy and is a type of financing that differs from a traditional bank loan. It's seeing explosive growth.

title: AI disruption could spark a ‘shock to the system’ in credit markets, UBS analyst says
content: UBS analyst Matthew Mish told CNBC that the artificial intelligence transformation is happening faster than he and his colleagues had previously anticipated.

title: Michael Saylor downplays Strategy credit risk as bitcoin tumbles: 'We'll refinance the debt'
content: Strategy plans to continue refinancing its debt and buying bitcoin, even as the token tumbles, CEO Michael Saylor said Tuesday on CNBC's "Squawk Box."

title: Fixed-income ETF provider BondBloxx questions private credit meltdown fears, sees space as sensible way to generate income
content: BondBloxx's Joanna Gallegos, J.P. Morgan's former head of global ETF strategy, is confident private credit is a sensible way for investors to pursue income.

title: Rocket Companies shares jump 6% after CEO says mortgage loan volume is surging
content: CEO Varun Krishna said his company is poised to post its strongest mortgage loan production in four years after a drop in borrowing costs helped revive demand.

title: Trump administration identifies more borrowers eligible for student loan forgiveness, court filing shows
content: The Trump administration identified more than 40,000 borrowers eligible for federal student loan relief in January, a recent court filing shows.

title: Parents with student loans have a short window to secure affordable repayment and forgiveness
content: Parents with student debt may be excluded from affordable repayment plans and loan forgiveness in the coming months if they don't take certain steps soon.

title: Student loan complaints hit record high, CFPB finds — but the watchdog agency omits details
content: The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's latest student loan report cites a record number of complaints from borrowers but leaves out certain information.

title: Some student loan borrowers wait over a year in public servant debt forgiveness backlog
content: More than 83,000 federal student loan borrowers are waiting for a Public Service Loan Forgiveness Buyback application decision. What experts say to do while in line.

title: How Trump's child tax credit changes could impact your refund this season
content: The maximum child tax credit increased to $2,200 in 2025 based on changes enacted via President Donald Trump's "big beautiful bill."

title: Older workers with student loan debt have less saved for retirement, Fidelity finds
content: Older workers with student debt have much smaller retirement account balances than their peers without the loans, a Fidelity report shows.
